HeroSection.heading: Experience the Soul of Marrakech
HeroSection.subheading: A cozy family riad in the heart of the Medina where Moroccan hospitality meets authentic culture.

AboutSection.heading: A Peaceful Retreat in the Heart of the Medina
AboutSection.body1: Nestled within the ancient walls of Marrakech's Medina, Riad Della is a family-run guesthouse where traditional Moroccan hospitality comes alive. Behind an unassuming door lies a peaceful courtyard—a world away from the vibrant energy of the souks just steps outside.
AboutSection.body2: We invite you to slow down, sip mint tea beneath the orange trees, and experience the warmth of a culture that has welcomed travelers for centuries. This is not just a place to stay—it's a place to belong.

medina.title: Authentic Medina
medina.description: Step outside your door into centuries of living history, winding alleyways, and the true heartbeat of Marrakech.

breakfast.title: Moroccan Breakfast
breakfast.description: Wake to freshly baked msemen, local honey, seasonal fruits, and traditional Moroccan mint tea each morning.

terrace.title: Rooftop Terrace
terrace.description: Watch the sun set over the Medina rooftops with views stretching to the Atlas Mountains.

hospitality.title: Heartfelt Hospitality
hospitality.description: We're not a hotel—we're a family. Let us share our favorite corners of Marrakech with you.

courtyard.title: Peaceful Courtyard
courtyard.description: The gentle sound of our fountain, the scent of orange blossom—a sanctuary in the middle of the city.

culture.title: Cultural Immersion
culture.description: From cooking classes to guided souk walks, we help you connect with Moroccan traditions.

DiscoverSection.heading: A City That Awakens Every Sense

medina.title: The Medina
medina.text: A UNESCO World Heritage Site of labyrinthine streets, centuries-old architecture, and endless discovery.

souks.title: The Souks
souks.text: A sensory journey through spice stalls, handcrafted leather, intricate metalwork, and vibrant textiles.

cuisine.title: Moroccan Cuisine
cuisine.text: From street-side tagine to rooftop dining, taste the flavors of saffron, cumin, and preserved lemon.

guided.title: Guided Experiences
guided.text: Let us arrange private tours to Jardin Majorelle, the Saadian Tombs, or a traditional hammam.

sophie.quote: Riad Della felt like coming home to a place we'd never been. The courtyard, the breakfast, the warmth of the family—everything was heartfelt and genuine.
sophie.author: Sophie & Laurent

james.quote: We've stayed in many riads across Morocco, but none captured the authentic spirit of the Medina quite like this one. We left as friends, not guests.
james.author: James & Emma

anna.quote: The rooftop terrace at sunset was unforgettable. Mint tea in hand, the Atlas Mountains glowing—this is the Marrakech we came to find.
anna.author: Anna K.

LocationSection.heading: In the Heart of the Medina
LocationSection.description: Located in the authentic Medina of Marrakech, within walking distance of the souks and historic landmarks. Our neighborhood, Zaouia Abbassia, is one of the most peaceful corners of the old city—far enough from the tourist bustle, yet close to everything that matters.

CtaSection.heading: Your Marrakech Escape Awaits
CtaSection.subheading: Whether you're seeking a romantic getaway, a cultural journey, or simply a place to pause—we're here to welcome you home.

RoomsHero.heading: Rooms & Suites at Riad Della
RoomsHero.subheading: Peaceful rooms designed in the spirit of traditional Moroccan hospitality.

RoomsIntro.heading: Comfort, Calm & Authenticity
RoomsIntro.body: At Riad Della, each room is designed to offer comfort, calm, and authenticity. Inspired by traditional Moroccan architecture and decorated with handcrafted details, our rooms provide a peaceful retreat after exploring the vibrant Medina of Marrakech.

lina.name: Lina — Double Room
lina.description: An elegant double room inspired by traditional Moroccan craftsmanship. Warm textiles, hand-carved details, and serene comfort invite you to slow down and rest.

maya.name: Room Maya — Double Room
maya.description: A tranquil haven combining authentic Moroccan artisanal style with modern comfort. Featuring heated floors, fine bedding, and a calming aesthetic for total relaxation.

amel.name: Amel — Double Deluxe
amel.description: A generously proportioned Double Deluxe with premium finishes and a heated floor underfoot. Step outside to enjoy the plunging heated pool or unwind by the fireplace.

asma.name: Asma — Triple Room
asma.description: Perfect for families or a group of friends, Asma offers three beds and easy access to the rooftop terrace and the shared fireplace lounge.

della.name: Suite Della
della.description: A spacious Moroccan suite accommodating up to 3 guests with refined artisanal details, plush bedding, heated floors, and supreme comfort. Direct access to the rooftop terrace and heated plunge pool.

douiria.name: Suite Della
douiria.description: A spacious Moroccan suite accommodating up to 3 guests with refined artisanal details, plush bedding, heated floors, and supreme comfort. Direct access to the rooftop terrace and heated plunge pool.

GolfHero.heading: Golf in the Heart of Morocco
GolfHero.subheading: Stay in a boutique riad and tee off at one of Morocco's finest courses, just 15 minutes away.

GolfIntro.heading: Luxury Stays, World-Class Golf
GolfIntro.body: Riad Della pairs the intimacy of a traditional Moroccan riad with effortless access to Golf Royal de Marrakech. We take care of every detail — so you arrive at the first tee relaxed and ready.

GolfCourse.heading: A Course Worth Travelling For
GolfCourse.description: One of Morocco's most prestigious golf clubs, just 15 minutes from Riad Della.

course.title: 18-Hole Championship Course
course.text: Designed in 1923, Golf Royal de Marrakech is one of Africa's oldest and most celebrated courses, set among century-old olive and orange trees.

distance.title: 15 Minutes Away
distance.text: We arrange private transfers door-to-door, so you spend your time playing, not planning.

setting.title: Stunning Scenery

SpaHero.heading: Restore. Renew. Unwind.
SpaHero.subheading: Immerse yourself in centuries-old Moroccan wellness rituals — from the deep purification of the hammam to the healing touch of argan oil massage.

SpaIntro.heading: The Art of the Moroccan Hammam
SpaIntro.body: The hammam is at the heart of Moroccan culture — a ritual of cleansing, relaxation, and renewal practised for centuries. At Riad Della, we bring this tradition to you in an intimate, private setting using authentic products: savon beldi, kessa gloves, ghassoul clay, and pure argan oil from the Moroccan heartland.

steamBath.title: Steam Bath
steamBath.description: The steam bath stimulates pore dilation and promotes sweating, helping to eliminate toxins and impurities accumulated daily. Your skin will be perfectly prepared to receive all treatments and care offered.

expressBath.title: Express Bath
expressBath.description: Discover the traditional Moroccan exfoliation experience, including a full-body cleanse with black soap, followed by a deep scrub using a Kessa glove. Your hair will enjoy an intensive shampoo and a scalp massage, leaving your body silky smooth and your hair shiny.

royalBath.title: Bain Royal Della
royalBath.description: A complete treatment combining steam and black soap, followed by a scrub with a Kessa glove, a gentle rub with argan soap, a scalp mask, and a hair massage with argan-based serum. A gentle coffee scrub is also included. To finish, your body will be cleansed with a nourishing shower oil.

orientalRelax.title: Oriental Relaxation Massage
orientalRelax.description: Treat your skin to a vitamin E boost with a relaxing argan oil massage. Your body will feel rested and your skin deeply moisturised for an immediate silky-smooth effect.

tonicMassage.title: Toning Massage
tonicMassage.description: Natural and pure, the candle contains plant oils and pure essential oils. These warm, smooth oils deeply nourish the skin to improve texture and sensation. This massage combines gentle effleurage, deep strokes, and broad, flowing, enveloping movements, promoting greater skin elasticity.

bathMassagePackage.title: Bath & Oriental Massage Package
bathMassagePackage.description: A package designed for your comfort. Enjoy a full express bath — traditional Moroccan black soap cleanse and Kessa glove scrub, plus an intensive scalp shampoo and massage — followed by a relaxing argan oil massage for deeply hydrated, radiant skin.

SpaHighlights.heading: A Ritual Worth Experiencing
SpaHighlights.subheading: Everything about our spa is designed to feel authentic, personal, and deeply restorative.

products.title: Authentic Moroccan Products
products.description: We use only genuine savon beldi, ghassoul clay, kessa gloves, and argan oil — sourced from traditional Moroccan producers.

private.title: Intimate & Private Setting
private.description: Your session takes place within the riad itself, in a calm and fully private atmosphere away from any tourist bustle.

therapists.title: Experienced Therapists
therapists.description: Our therapists are trained in traditional Moroccan techniques and will tailor every session to your needs and comfort.

TransportationHero.heading: Travel Without the Hassle
TransportationHero.subheading: From airport arrivals to day trips across Morocco, we handle every transfer so you can focus on enjoying your stay.

TransportationIntro.heading: Seamless Transfers, Every Time
TransportationIntro.body: At Riad Della, we believe the journey is part of the experience. Whether you're arriving at the airport, heading to a restaurant, or exploring the landscapes beyond the city, our private transfer service ensures you travel in comfort, on time, and without worry.

shuttle.title: Airport Shuttle
